documented_probe: C-57f213ee (featurize SMILES strings into model-input arrays; min difficulty hard): the task demands a byte-exact reproduction of a published multi-stage tokenization + rolling-hash featurization (bracket spans, two-letter tokens, invalid-character and unclosed-bracket zero vectors, positional binning) exercised on three hidden SMILES lists plus a catalog-derived features.npz. The covering task exercises the capability fully on hidden cases.
notes: Single-stage: implement the exact deterministic featurizer and run it on the visible catalog. Hard floor from adversarial inputs (unclosed brackets, whitespace, non-ASCII, tabs, foreign tokens), hidden_case_generalization (three hidden lists) and quantitative_correctness (byte-exact float32 comparison). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure.
